use_case_summary: Mariner Logix is evaluating Redwood Hosted API for an SMB customer-support SaaS. Primary workloads: conversational chat for customers (low-latency) and document embeddings for KB search. Needs public-cloud hosted option with per-tenant retention controls and explicit opt-out for collecting prompts. Wants non-consentable customer accounts not to be stored in logs and a deletion API to remove any stored prompts quickly.
security_summary: Key asks: explicit statement that hosted prompts will not be used for model training; per-tenant retention TTL (ability to set 0/30/90 days); deletion API with audit trail; SSO/SAML for console; exportable audit logs for admin actions; guidance on handling PII in prompts. Also wants an example JSON snippet for retention config to include in their security pack.
technical_requirements: API-level retention flagging (e.g., X-Redwood-retention: 30d or retention=none), per-tenant opt-out, deletion endpoints with request-id for audit, and exportable activity logs. p95 latency target ~400ms for chat; batch embeddings asynchronously.
commercial_notes: SMB — price sensitive. Likely start with hosted API pay-as-you-go. If retention features cost extra, may still convert but ARR small (1k-10k). Wants a short legal statement we can include in TOS and customer-facing docs.
